title: The first film money and the rumoured Bing and Cab clash
summary: They made so much on The Big Broadcast of 1934 that pay arrangements changed; Hinton asks about friction between Bing and Cab.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Right. That's where we were making the big money. Then the first movie we made was The Big Broadcast
of 1934. That was with Bing Crosby. And we made so much money on that, that they changed the way we played.

Well, from what I hear... Would you explain this to me? I think this is very important, and I would like to have it on the record. They tell me Bing Crosby and Cab had a little confrontation in that. Two big dogs...
Well, I didn't know too much about it. It's a possibility. See...
But did you hear about it?
No, I didn't hear about it. The first I heard about it is when you told me. But I believe it's so, because knowing Cab...
Well, down through the years, you know, Bing Crosby never ...(?)... do things Cab's way.
